product_summary: ION Science India is the Indian office/distributor-service centre of UK gas-detection maker ION Science Ltd (HQ Fowlmere, Royston, UK). Per ionscience.com contact page (fetched): 'ION Science India — Distributor · Office · Service Centre, Serves: India, Flat No. 306, Kadiris Apurupa Urban, Sy. No. 196, Botanical Garden Road, Kondapur, Hyderabad – 500084, Telangana, info@ionscience-india.com, +91-40 4853 6129'. Product range from ionscience.com/in/en/products/ (22 products, fetched): portable PID VOC detectors Tiger XT / Tiger XTL / Tiger XT Select (benzene-selective); wearable PID monitors Cub 10.0/10.6/11.7 eV; fixed PID detectors FALCO 2 (10.0/10.6/11.7 eV), TVOC 2, Titan 2 selective benzene monitor; Panther portable gas leak detector; SF6 LeakCheck P1 XTL and SF6 Leakmate portable leak detectors; SF6 AreaCheck P2 fixed SF6 detector; MVI portable mercury vapour detector; ARA-series wearable single/multi-gas detectors (H2S, CO, O2, SO2, ARA-X4); Hydrosteel 6500 hydrogen flux monitor; plus PID lamps/sensors and calibration/service. Mapping: gas/vapour analysing and detecting instruments = 9027.10 (main line); leak detectors for SF6/compressed gas = 9026.20/9026.80; mercury vapour analyser = 9027.80; PID sensor lamps and spare sensor cells = 9027.90 (parts) or 8539/8541 depending on item; fixed detectors with alarm signalling = 8531.10 (burglar/fire/gas alarms) as an alternative classification. Declared 903180 ('other measuring/checking instruments') is a generic residual heading that can cover some handheld multi-parameter instruments but is not the specific heading for gas/VOC analysers, so the match is partial, not exact.
comment: HS 903180 vs actual product line: PARTIAL. The declared code is a residual 'other measuring or checking instruments' heading; the real catalogue is dominated by gas/VOC/benzene/mercury/SF6 detecting and analysing instruments, which belong primarily in 9027.10 (gas or smoke analysis apparatus), with leak detectors in 9026.20/9026.80, mercury vapour in 9027.80, sensor cells/lamps in 9027.90 and fixed alarm-type units possibly 8531.10. Per project rule 3 the company is NOT rejected on HS grounds — code should be corrected to the actual line (902710 primary, with 902620/902680/902790/853110 as secondary lines). Industry label 'IT и электроника' is a MISCLASSIFICATION: this is industrial safety / process instrumentation (gas detection), not IT or consumer electronics. Trader signs: the Indian entity is listed by the UK manufacturer as 'Distributor · Office · Service Centre' for India, i.e. sales/service arm of a foreign principal, not a manufacturer — role trader (import/distribution + service), with possible local assembly/calibration activity not evidenced. Product lines missing from the declaration: PID sensor lamps and replacement sensor cells, calibration gases/accessories, service and repair — these are separate HS lines (parts 9027.90, lamps 8539) and are not reflected in a single 903180 code. All product claims above are from the company/group website catalogue only; no customs line was available to me in this task, therefore the specific shipment-level HS codes are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — the product range itself is documented on ionscience.com, but the actual declared/used HS codes per shipment are not corroborated here. Note: ionscience-india.com resolves to the same group site content; no separate India-specific catalogue page with prices/HS was found.
